landing.topTag: Tamil Nadu Higher Education Skill Ecosystem Project
landing.heroDescription: Connecting students and faculty through objective competency assessments, transparent skill-gap identification, tailored faculty learning roadmaps, and career matching.
landing.coreArchSubtitle: Designed specifically to solve the disconnect between classroom curriculum and industry-ready skills.
landing.featureCompDesc: Diagnostic, adaptive multiple-choice tests assessing programming, relational databases, data structures, and communication without bias.
landing.featureGapDesc: Pinpoints exact technical deficiencies (e.g. SQL joins, system design) with clear severity levels and constructive recommended steps.
landing.featureFacultyDesc: Faculty members review cohort gaps and directly assign curated PDF guides, practice exercises, and videos to students needing support.
landing.featureRoadmapDesc: Week-wise milestone plans broken into manageable modules with trackable task completions to prepare students for target roles.
landing.featureMatchDesc: Separates vector-based Career Fit % from transparent rule-based Career Readiness %, providing honest feedback on placement suitability.
landing.featurePassportDesc: Student-controlled public profile with fine-grained privacy toggles and QR code generation for recruiter presentations.
landing.step1Desc: Student builds their academic record and completes an adaptive multi-competency assessment.
landing.step2Desc: The platform computes competency vectors and flags gaps (e.g. low SQL score) relative to industry roles.
landing.step3Desc: Faculty analyzes cohort heatmaps and assigns targeted learning notes, tasks, or video lectures.
landing.step4Desc: Student completes learning activities, retakes the evaluation, and shares their verified Skill Passport.
landing.studentPortalDesc: Access your personalized competency distribution, view identified skill gaps, complete faculty-assigned learning modules, and prepare for placement interviews.
landing.facultyPortalDesc: Monitor cohort skill heatmaps, assign targeted remedial resources to students needing support, manage assessment question banks, and export CSV reports.
